about.title: How TasteAbroad works
about.intro: Rankings and price tell you where you could study. TasteAbroad answers the three questions that decide whether you will be happy there: will the culture of the city feel like home, can you study in a language you speak, and can you afford it?
about.stepsTitle: What happens when you press the button
about.step1: You type what you love: artists, films, shows, food, hobbies, brands or places.
about.step2: An AI agent (Google Gemini) reads your list and calls tools. First it looks up every like on Qloo: a specific name becomes a Qloo entity (Dua Lipa, Studio Ghibli), a genre or hobby becomes a Qloo tag (techno, street food, hiking).
about.step3: With those signals the agent asks Qloo's taste graph to score {count} university cities worldwide by taste affinity, and also fetches Qloo's top destinations around the world.
about.step4: It asks Qloo what else people with the same taste like (music, films, TV, places).
about.step5: It reads our curated data for the best cities: well-known universities, typical international tuition, a monthly student budget and the languages you can study in.
about.step6: Finally the AI writes a short explanation for each city that refers to what you typed. In the compare view, Qloo also suggests places inside each city that people like you love.
about.roleQloo: Qloo decides which cities fit, how strongly and in what order. Every match score is Qloo's own affinity value, shown unchanged as a percentage. The AI never sets or changes a score.
about.roleAi: The AI decides which Qloo lookups to make and puts the results into words. It can only use cities and IDs that Qloo actually returned.
about.roleData: Universities, tuition and living costs come from our own dataset. They are rough ranges, so always check the official university site.
about.reliability: If the AI is busy or rate-limited, a backup pipeline calls the same Qloo tools in a fixed order, so you still get results. Identical searches are cached for 30 minutes and every visitor has a fair-use limit to protect the free API quotas.
about.limitsTitle: What the results do not mean
about.limits: Qloo describes what groups of people with similar tastes enjoy. A high score is not a prediction about you, and it says nothing about admission chances, visas or safety.
about.privacy: No account, no tracking. Only the things you type are sent to Qloo and Gemini to compute the result. Your search lives in the page link so you can share it.
